changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2: GLOBAL > AUDIO ROUTING > DAC SUM routes every voice to the main mix through the DAC.
With DAC SUM on, press FILTER twice for DAC FILTER: a per-voice filter (FRQ, RES, TYP, DEP), a transient shaper (ATK, SUS) and polarity.
The page shows only the knobs the selected sound's TYP uses: no RES for LP1 and HP1, neither FRQ nor RES with TYP OFF.
Filter settings are kept with the sound, DAC SUM with the global slot.
